spec.description:
Identify over-provisioned PVCs and rank worst offenders ("bad students") by project label.

Underutilization criteria: capacity > 15 GiB AND peak utilization over the last 7 days < 20%.

Absolute & relative savings are estimated by (capacity - peak_used_over_7d). Uses pvc:* recording rules.

spec.title: Total wasted capacity (7d max)
spec.description: Sum of (capacity - max_used_over_7d) across all PVCs that (a) have >15 GiB capacity and (b) never exceeded 20% utilization in the last 7 days.

options.content: Over-provisioned PVCs to shrink. **Flagged when**: capacity **> 15 GiB** AND peak utilization over 7d **< 20 %**. Wasted = capacity − peak used (7d).

spec.title: Wasted capacity over time
spec.description: Reclaimable bytes over the selected range. Flat means nobody is acting on it; a step down is a volume actually being shrunk.

spec.title: Offending PVCs
spec.description: Number of PVCs matching the underutilization criteria.

spec.expr:
count(
  pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20
  and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
  pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3
)

spec.title: Capacity of flagged PVCs
spec.description: Sum of capacity across all PVCs that match the underutilization criteria. This is the total allocated storage sitting in over-provisioned volumes.

spec.expr:
sum(
  pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
  and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
  (pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20)
  and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
  (pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3)
)

spec.title: Reclaimable share of total PVC storage
spec.description: Share of total PVC storage (across ALL PVCs in $cluster) that is reclaimable from flagged volumes. Formula: wasted_bytes(flagged) / capacity_bytes(all PVCs).

spec.expr:
sum(
  (pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} - pvc:used_bytes:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
  and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
  (pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20)
  and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
  (pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3)
)
/
sum(pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})

spec.title: Project leaderboard
spec.description: Wasted & provisioned per project with waste ratio. Sort by wasted desc to find the evil imps.

spec.expr:
sum by (label_project) (
  (
    (pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} - pvc:used_bytes:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
    and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
    (pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20)
    and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
    (pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3)
  )
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left(label_project)
  max by (cluster, namespace, label_project) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster"})
)

count by (label_project) (
  (
    (pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20)
    and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
    (pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3)
  )
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left(label_project)
  max by (cluster, namespace, label_project) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster"})
)

spec.title: Offending PVCs (sortable)
spec.description: One row per underutilized PVC. Sort by any column. Filter by project using the variable.

spec.expr:
(
  pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left(label_project) max by (cluster, namespace, label_project) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_project=~"$project"})
)
and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
(pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20)
and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
(pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3)

pvc:used_bytes:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
(pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20)
and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
(pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3)
and on (cluster, namespace)
(max by (cluster, namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_project=~"$project"}))

pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
(pvc:utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < 0.20)
and on (cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
(pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 15 * 1024^3)
and on (cluster, namespace)
(max by (cluster, namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_project=~"$project"}))
